meta.audience: people who want to make a small beat every day
meta.title: Tiny Beat
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/index.css in the app repository) and its captured screens. A black groovebox with chrome knobs, lime LED pads and a green LCD; the reel plays its sequencer in time with its own music, step by step.

source.notes: a web groovebox: 16 steps, 4 drum and 2 melody tracks synthesized with Web Audio, a daily seeded beat in four genres, archive, share links, WAV export
the real app (its production build, served locally, date pinned to 2026-10-12) captured by capture/app.json; pads.json holds the pad states read from those captures
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (its mono face, labels and LCD); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's device: near-black #060607 and #111113 panels, chrome for knobs and keys, text #F3F3F1 / #B9B9BF / #8F8F97, and the lime LED #C6F432 with its hot #E2FF7A and deep #5B7412 steps for lit pads, the LCD and anything that sounds.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable for headlines, heavy and tight, white with the second line lime; the app's chrome wordmark ('Tiny Beat.' with a lime dot) is used as captured; JetBrains Mono capitals for labels and readouts, as on the device ('WEB AUDIO GROOVEBOX', 'BPM 073').
rationale.motion: Clocked: a playhead sweeps the 16 steps once per bar in time with the reel's music, and every lit pad it passes flashes; LED rows count the beats; panels drop in with a short damped spring like hardware being set down. Between hits the device breathes with the beat.
rationale.sound: Lo-fi in A minor at 80 BPM (5 bars in 15 s, 10 in 30 s): today's beat in the app is a lo-fi in A minor, so the reel's music is the same genre in the same key, with organic SFX (taps on pads, a soft click for the dice).
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the chrome wordmark lands over a row of LEDs counting the steps; the real sequencer plays today's lo-fi beat, each pad flashing as the playhead passes; the daily seed rolls through lo-fi, house, break and ambient, the real sequencer changing pattern with it; the end card. The 30 s cut adds the mixer and WAV export.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
